csv_project_name: Design-Build for I-64 Exit 211 Interchange Improvements
csv_scope_of_work: The State of Virginia, Department of Transportation, may be seeking a Consultant to provide design-build project from qualified and experienced respondents with design and construction experience for the I-64 at Exit 211 Interchange Improvement. The project scope includes converting the existing interchange into a four-lane diverging diamond interchange. The proposed improvements include widening Route 106, new bridge construction, sidewalks, widening and reconstruction of four ramps, drainage, stormwater management facilities, traffic signals and lighting. The work includes but is not limited to: roadway and bridge design, survey, environmental, geotechnical, hydraulics and stormwater management, traffic control devices, transportation management plan, traffic signals, utility relocation, quality assurance and quality control, construction engineering and inspection, and overall project management.
csv_disciplines_requested: Design Build/Developer, Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Surveying/GIS/Mapping, Construction/Project Management, Inspection Services, Environmental Engineering/Planning/Design, Utility Engineering, Hydrology/Hydraulics, Stormwater, Wastewater Treatment Engineering, Traffic Design Engineering
